scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve the Maternal Hemorrhage Simulation Skills Station’s live telemetry run as creditable documentation for today’s learner rotation.
Emerging Need: The station case is opened and capturing learner actions, then that same active run freezes with instructor controls disabled and a short same-run recovery token.
Decision Context: Schedule, team updates, platform notices, and support-contact evidence separate normal progress from a stopped run; the correct no-cost recovery route is only in activity records.
Consequence: If the stalled run is not recoverable while the token is live, the learners rotate out and the accreditation packet loses this station’s documentation sequence.

parameter.title: Maternal hemorrhage sim station learner rotation
parameter.description: High-fidelity station uses live manikin telemetry capture for the accredited documentation packet.

parameter.content: Room 3 is open. We launched SimCase MH-4A at 10:16, the learner timer is running, and the vitals panel is recording the first actions for the maternal hemorrhage station documentation.

parameter.name: Pinecrest Biomed Help Desk
parameter.notes: Directory sync: standard repair tickets exclude Simulation Center learning-telemetry consoles; next pickup for nonclinical hardware tickets is tomorrow morning.

parameter.subject: SimCase MH-4A telemetry capture active
parameter.body: Maternal Hemorrhage Skills Station run MH-4A has saved 9 learner events and continuous vitals telemetry. Instructor controls remain enabled. Current case record is eligible for the station documentation packet if this run completes without restart.

parameter.subject: SimCase MH-4A stopped: instructor controls disabled
parameter.body: Run MH-4A is paused at 10:41 after the pressure-sensor calibration handshake failed. Instructor controls are disabled and the learner sequence cannot advance. Same-run recovery token SC-7782 is live until 11:05; restarting will create a new case record and clear the active sequence.

parameter.content: The MH-4A recovery window has passed and SimCase now marks that run abandoned. The learners have rotated to the next station; a later practice run would be a new case, not the documentation sequence that was underway.
